name: ledger_timeline
description: Write a run's dated ledger entries as one timeline in time order (Markdown table, CSV or JSON Lines). Leaves out corrected entries, duplicates (rel duplicates) and seqs in exclude, counting each; kinds, since/until and match narrow it; a sensitive entry is withheld unless asked; redact withholds patterns. Marks corrections, attests and disputes.

output.description: File to write the timeline to, under your work directory (.md, .csv or .jsonl picks the format)

ledger.description: The ledger's entries (default ledger/entries.jsonl); attestations.jsonl and disputes.jsonl beside it are read too

format.description: Output format (default: from the output's extension, else markdown)

kinds.description: Entry kinds to take (default ["event"]); an entry of another kind is taken only if it has a time

exclude.description: Entry numbers to leave out (7, "7" or "#7"), e.g. one event mirrored by another

keep_duplicates.description: Keep entries that say they duplicate another (rel duplicates); default false

include_superseded.description: Keep corrected entries beside their corrections, marked; default false

since.description: Earliest UTC time or date to keep (ISO 8601)

until.description: Latest UTC time or date to keep, inclusive at the precision given (ISO 8601)

match.description: Case-insensitive regex an entry's value, source, evidence or clock must match

sensitive.description: An entry marked sensitive: its words withheld and its number kept (default), shown, or left out

redact.description: Regexes whose matches are replaced by [withheld] in every kept row

note.description: A paragraph under the heading: scope, caveats, clocks

columns.description: Columns in order, from time, event, kind, source, evidence, clock, precision, confidence, refs, by, entry (default time, event, clock, entry)

link.description: Where each E-n links in Markdown (default: ledger.md beside the entries, relative to the output; empty for none)
